_comment: Login smoke for env/smoke.cjs (see env/README.md, 'Smoke check'). No passwords here: env/smoke.cjs reads them at run time from sormas-api/src/main/java/de/symeda/sormas/api/utils/DefaultEntityHelper.java. PoeInf (POE_INFORMANT) has SORMAS_REST but not SORMAS_UI, so the web login refuses it by design (errorNoAccessToWeb in sormas-api strings.properties). CfgUser is a seed user of C2 only (env/seed/extend.sh) and has NatUser's password; users with 'configs' are checked on copies of those configurations only.
